svg.title: Footnote: IBM Plex Sans
svg.desc: A lowercase a with a raised asterisk, both outlined from IBM Plex Sans Bold (SIL Open Font License, which allows outlines in a logo): a word with a note on it, the plainest sign that something is cited. The wordmark is IBM Plex Sans Semibold, outlined. Plex's a has a flat-topped, engineered shape that suits documentation as code. Weak in that it's IBM's house face, and its character pulls away from the system fonts the pages use.
